sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take on any turn you are currently Grappling a creature
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Bio Branch

system.description:
This jutsu can only be cast while you have a creature Grappled. You begin to forcefully siphon the targets will and strength from them, for yourself.

All creatures currently grappled by you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d6 chakra damage and gain a rank of Weakened for the next minute or half as much on a success. A creature weakened by this jutsu, remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition on a success.

You gain temporary hit points equal to the result of highest die rolled as part of this jutsu’s chakra damage and increase the next instance of damage you deal by +4, for every rank of Weakened inflicted by this jutsu.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6, and the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1.
